user.title: Hegel Connect
user.description:
Enter the IP address of your Hegel H150, H200, H400 or H600.

Tip: give it a fixed address in your router.

*Unofficial integration, not affiliated with Hegel.*

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the amplifier, e.g. 192.168.1.50

discovery_confirm.title: Hegel Connect
discovery_confirm.description:
**{name}** found at {host}.

Add to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the amplifier on this address. Is it on the network (also works in standby)?
error.not_supported: A device answered, but it does not look like a Hegel H150, H200, H400 or H600.
error.legacy_model: This is an older Hegel amplifier (H95, H120, H190, H390, H590 or Röst). It is controlled with Hegel's IP control protocol: use Home Assistant's built-in [Hegel integration]({core_url}). Hegel Connect is for the H150, H200, H400 and H600.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Hegel H150, H200, H400 or H600.
abort.already_in_progress: This amplifier is already being set up.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different amplifier. Add that one as a new device.

command_failed.message: The Hegel did not accept the command: {error}

fixed_volume.message: This input uses fixed volume (home theater bypass); the volume cannot be changed here.

not_playable.message: Choose a station, album or track, not a folder.

browse_failed.message: Could not open this folder on the Hegel: {error}

init.title: Inputs
init.description: Hide inputs you do not use and give inputs your own name. This only changes how Home Assistant shows them (source list, dashboards), not the amplifier. Leave a name empty to keep the amplifier's name.

data_description.hidden_sources: Hidden inputs disappear from the source list and dashboards; automations can still select them.

error.duplicate_name: Two inputs would get the same name.

abort.no_inputs: The inputs are not known yet. Try again when the amplifier is connected.
